observations: Single photo shows a blue industrial gearbox/speed reducer unit sitting on bare ground.
Output shaft is visible on the right side, unpainted metal, no coupling attached.
A nameplate is visible on top of the housing but the text is too small/blurred to read.
A black cable is visible near the base but no separate electric motor unit is visible anywhere in the frame.
Watermark 'CHIDONBEST INDUSTRIAL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlay the image; these are platform/seller marks, not proof of the item's specs.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a gearbox-style housing with output shaft
No motor unit is visible in photo 0; only the gearbox is shown
Nameplate in photo 0 is present but text is unreadable

risks.risk: Nameplate details (brand, exact ratio, model, torque rating) cannot be read, so true specification and value are unknown.
risks.proof: A close-up, well-lit photo of the nameplate showing all engraved/printed text
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unbranded industrial gearbox of unknown ratio

risks.risk: The claimed 20hp electric motor is not shown at all; it may not be included in the sale or may not exist as described.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual motor unit including its own nameplate (hp, voltage, brand)
risks.if_unproven: priced as gearbox only, with no motor included

risks.risk: Working condition of the gearbox (internal gear wear, oil seal leaks, shaft play) cannot be assessed from a static photo.
risks.proof: A video clip of the unit running under load, or at minimum free hand-rotation of the output shaft showing no excessive play

risks.risk: Unit appears to be sitting on dirt/outdoor ground, suggesting possible storage exposure (rust, water ingress) not visible from this angle.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside, oil fill/drain plugs, and interior oil condition if accessible

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the gearbox nameplate (brand, model, ratio, torque rating).
Separate photo of the electric motor with its own nameplate showing hp, voltage, and brand.
Video of the unit running or shaft rotating freely to show working condition.
Photos from additional angles including underside and oil ports.
response.reason: The listing bundles a gearbox and a 20hp motor, but only the gearbox is visible and its nameplate is unreadable, so neither the motor's existence/specs nor the gearbox's exact rating can be confirmed, making even a worst-case price impossible without the missing nameplate and motor photos.
